`final class MsdfFontFace`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IFontFace`](/reference/text/ifontface/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.impl.msdf` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [MsdfFontFace.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/impl/msdf/MsdfFontFace.java)

One face of an MsdfFont, with its atlas texture, its metrics, its glyphs and its kerning.

## Description

An [`IMsdfSource`](/reference/text/imsdfsource/) reads it; [`MsdfFontLoader`](/reference/text/msdffontloader/) does that for you.
Metrics, advances and kerning are on 1 of the font size.

- [Fonts](/use/learn/going-further/fonts/)
- [MSDF text](/use/in-depth/msdf-text/)

## Creation details

<a id="MsdfFontFace-factory-of"></a>

### of

`MsdfFontFace of(MsdfAtlas atlas, MsdfMetrics metrics, Map<Integer,MsdfGlyph> glyphs, Map<Long,Float> kerningPairs, BufferedImage image, String name, FontWeight weight, boolean italic)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

**Throws:**

- `IllegalArgumentException`: A font face needs a name, got an empty one: give the face the name of its font

Creates a face from its atlas, its metrics, its glyphs by codepoint, its kerning pairs keyed by `pair(previous, current)`, the atlas image, its name, its weight and its style.
The image becomes a linear texture without mipmaps, uploaded the first time the face draws.
Throws `IllegalArgumentException` when `name` is empty.
